tile_uniform — DRIVE inf op

• Data kinds: none → scalar (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.tile_uniform(i: 'int', j: 'int', seed: 'int', salt: 'int' = 0) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import driveinf; driveinf.tile_uniform(i: 'int', j: 'int', seed: 'int', salt: 'int' = 0) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("tile_uniform"))

Usage

Maps the upper 53 bits of tile_hash to a uniform real number in [0, 1) (exactly representable in double precision).
